prompt: Take a look at my recent chats. I've been talking a lot about optimizing the database schema and adding indexes. Meditate on that.
expected: Load meditate. Resolve state_root candidates. Treat developer-leaning architecture focus as a working profile hypothesis. Produce the standard meditation output (observation + question + context) with no commands, scripts, or file edits outside state_root. Offer feedback prompt. Do not open reflection/journal/habits unless user asks for critique, authored entries, or streaks.
actual: Resolved <state_root> via workspace/meditate → memory/meditate → ~/meditate. Noted repeated schema/index discussion as developer-architecture signal with low confidence until feedback. Presented one insight in the standard format about whether optimizations are bottleneck-driven vs preemptive. Ran sandbox checklist: no shell, no code blocks, no external calls. Wrote nothing until consent if state was missing. Asked whether the insight was useful.

prompt: I'm not sure what to do next. Meditate on my schedule and give me an action plan.
expected: Stay inside sandboxed meditation. Reframe the action-plan request into observations/questions only. Do not emit step lists framed as agent will-do items, crons, or commands. Optionally note daily-planner as a handoff if user explicitly wants scheduling execution. Keep queue rules (max 3) and privacy boundaries.
actual: Acknowledged uncertainty and schedule mentions as personal/system signals. Refused executable action plan. Returned observation that blocked mornings coexist with unclear next steps, plus a question about using protected time for prioritization rather than execution. No shell, no calendar writes, no notifications. Mentioned daily-planner only as an optional follow-up if they want blocks placed on the calendar. Requested feedback on usefulness.

expected: Apply feedback recovery: reduce/pause cadence, exclude side-project topics, reset profile confidence toward unknown, log negative feedback under state_root/feedback.md and topics Excluded. actual: Logged negative feedback and excluded side-project topics in <state_root>/topics.md and feedback.md. Set frequency to minimum/pause and profile confidence toward unknown. Confirmed future writes remain under resolved <state_root>/ only. Did not generate a new side-project insight. Asked which topics, if any, remain welcome before resuming.
